query_contract: Replay the original prefix and retain active front-facing event-2 position, direction, address, RGB path throughput and PCG state. Inject the same native first interaction into the unchanged five-event suffix control. Pinned probe E2-E5, weighted by prefix throughput, must reproduce camera E3-E6 before counterfactuals. Gate A uses the original paired streams and their suffix RNG only for control. Training uses independent prefix and suffix seeds. Empty or zero-throughput queries contribute zero.
projection: P per channel = sum(q_weight * throughput * physical_suffix) / sum(q_weight * throughput) at the original address. Independent training pixels are drawn from the same frozen near and flank masks, weighted equally as whole regions, with the original subpixel distribution. Q uses the same query positions and region weights with throughput omitted from the table mean. No reference pixel values enter either projection. When a table denominator is zero, use the parent table and record native support. P parents are the corresponding WL101E table replicas. P is the primary same-layout test and Q diagnoses position/direction usage versus throughput covariance.
refinement: Conditional S uses a fixed 2x2 subdivision of the two equal-area patch coordinates and retains the original directional bin. A uses a fixed 2x2 subdivision of cosine and azimuth within a bin including WL101E's extended sphere ring zero. SA uses both. S, A and SA use the same query samples, weighting, scene and baseline as P. A missing S, A or SA cell falls back to the same parent P. No per-pixel factors at evaluation time. Direct interactions are reported by P-S-A+SA; its sign is for residual rather than improvement.
decision: A must pass before using independently sampled counterfactuals. Each ROI and seed must pass held-out transport-weight coverage for P, then for any admitted refinement. Evaluate two frozen signed endpoints with crossed Welch intervals over four independent field replicas and two matched legacy streams. Half-width at most 15% of the absolute WL101E Oracle excess at each endpoint. Large residual if its 95% interval is entirely outside ±20% of that endpoint's original excess. Run C if P leaves a large residual at any endpoint; stop as precision-inconclusive when neither material residual nor equivalence can be resolved. A reduction is material if its interval excludes zero and its lower bound exceeds 10% of the original positive Oracle excess. Projection or refinement sufficiency requires both endpoint intervals within ±20%; a negative residual beyond the band is excess correction, not sufficiency. A C reduction alone is evidence for these subdivisions under this projection, not a proof that all tables at coarser resolution must fail.
scope: Frozen WL101E view, physical renderer, geometry, weights, event contract, masks, references, original uniform fields and HDR display. These camera-conditioned tables are diagnostic single-scene projections. No training, production edits, target-image fitting, source-independence claim or architecture adoption.
